runs.narrative: In the abandoned nursery, I found myself amidst trays of dry compost and a glass under which they lay. I spotted a trowel on the floor and promptly picked it up, sensing its potential utility in my unknown mission. Moving further, I opened a door that led to the desolate furnace, once a blazing center of activity, now cold and silent. Here, I discovered a lantern, its once bright light now dimmed, lying on the floor. This seemingly insignificant lantern could be the key to illuminating my path in this mysterious place.

To the north, I discovered a furnace, while an east-facing colonnade leads to a place with broken pillars and a northward path to a vault. Along the way, I've collected a basket from the floor, though its purpose remains unclear. The remnants of this once vibrant place serve as a stark reminder of the world's current state. My actions are simple yet crucial: collecting tools and items, moving from one location to another, all in the hope of rebuilding or perhaps offering some semblance of comfort in this desolate landscape.
